verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a NerdGraph GraphQL API and an API explorer, but nothing about API versioning schemes, version pinning, or a documented deprecation policy and timeline. API lifecycle guarantees are a fair question for an observability SaaS platform, so the axis applies; having an API alone does not earn credit for versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
